summary: Declare a typed protocol and attach a correlated set of method implementations to a class.

capabilities.requirement: Support protocol declarations and class implementations from the playground.
Expose each method name, parameters, and return type as syntax-class fields.
Keep each repeated method aligned with its parameter list, return type, and implementation body.
Introduce the protocol's type and value bindings for later implementations and calls.
Recognize an implements form between a class name and protocol application at item scope.

syntaxNotes: Protocol methods use TypeScript parameter and return-type syntax.
The implements form appears after the class declaration and registers one implementation object.
Method dispatch uses the protocol value binding produced by the declaration.

openDecisions.question: Permit identifier operators such as implements in item context?
